crossRefs.note: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

translations.web: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.
translations.bsb: By me princes rule, and all nobles who govern justly.
translations.kjv: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
translations.asv: By me princes rule, And nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
